documents.unit: Center for Effective Teaching and Learning (CETL)
documents.title: Recommendations for Teaching & Learning with AI
documents.stance_why: The page sets no campus-wide rule; it says "it is good idea to develop your own AI policy" and describes what faculty who "oppose all use", "encourage the use of AI in all circumstances", or "fall somewhere in between" should write. Because the decision is handed to each instructor along those three options, the stance is delegates.
documents.summary: Cal State LA CETL guidance advising faculty to write their own AI policy, with advice for ban, embrace and in-between positions. It explains why AI detectors are not relied on (the campus has no Turnitin AI detection), how to handle suspected misuse by conversation, and offers assignment redesign and AI-use activity ideas. The academic honesty policy is noted as under revision to include AI.
